extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policy analysts, and economists needing country-level GDP statistics
extracted.subtask_description: Tabular country-level economic data (ranked lists) presenting country name, ranks, and GDP indicators (dollar totals, real growth rates, and GDP per capita) with the date of each estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rank
rubrics_metrics.description: Column labeled 'Rank' giving the ordinal position of each country/territory in the list (e.g., 1, 2, 3 ...). Appears at the start of each row.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country
rubrics_metrics.description: Column labeled 'Country' showing the name of the country or territory (includes special entries like 'World', 'European Union', and dependent territories).

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP (dollar amount; year estimate)
rubrics_metrics.description: Column showing GDP dollar amounts for each country with the year/estimate indicator (examples in text: '$142,200,000,000 2003 est.', '$1,500,000 1993 est.'). The chunk presents large lists of dollar values with accompanying year/estimate notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - real growth rate(%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Header shown exactly as 'GDP - real growth rate(%)' with an adjacent 'Date of Information' column; lists real GDP growth rates as percentages (e.g., '29.00', '9.10', '3.80').

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - per capita
rubrics_metrics.description: Header shown exactly as 'GDP - per capita' with an adjacent 'Date of Information' column; lists GDP per capita in dollars for each country/territory (e.g., '$55,100 2003 est.').

rubrics_metrics.name: Date of Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Column or annotation indicating the date or year of the estimate (e.g., '2003 est.', '2002 est.', '1999 est.', or specific year references). Appears alongside dollar amounts or growth-rate entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rank code / section marker
rubrics_metrics.description: Section markers such as 'Rank code: @2003' and 'Rank code: @2004' that indicate which ranking/metric set follows (separates different metric tables within the file).

rubrics_metrics.name: File update metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Document-level metadata lines such as 'This file was last updated on 10 February, 2005' that indicate the last update timestamp for the dataset.
